steps.content: In the empty office, the sea of fire burns, and monsters surge out of nowhere.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Get lost! Aren't you supposed to eliminate otherworld infiltrators like me? Why are you after her?

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: That one's a real coward. I'm not letting you through.
Right after saying that, the chat connected to Rise's mind starts buzzing, giving her a headache.

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: Rise, where are you? I'll help you!

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: You're not a Sinner. What can you do to help? Just run!
Bagel clearly can't hear Rise's voice. Instead of running, she sends more messages.

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>[Bagel]</color>: I...

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>[Bagel]</color>: Rise? Answer me. Please be safe!

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>[Bagel]</color>: I've always been a pushover who couldn't hold down a job.

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>[Bagel]</color>: If it weren't for you, I wouldn't have realized how useless I am...

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>[Bagel]</color>: If I run away and leave you behind, I won't forgive myself.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: ...Come on, would you stop it, please?

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: Waaahhhh...
A barrage of voice messages erupts like firecrackers.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Quit whining! While you're wallowing in self-pity, your account got hacked by the mole! Do you want to take the blame again?

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: Huh?? No, it wasn't me, please believe me, it really wasn't, I beg you...
Her reaction makes Rise even angrier.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Begging me for what?!!! I'm the mole!!

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: I messed up again. I'm really done for this time... I'm definitely going to get fired... Rise, please, for old times' sake, don't do this... I'll do anything you want, just don't...
She types with trembling fingers, tears almost spilling over.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: ...Damn it. This is exactly what I expected. I could have finished this, but the thought of you sitting here crying and begging gives me a headache, so I came back.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Clear your mind and think through the whole thing. Now answer me...

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: You saw a friendless newbie and reached out to help her. Anything wrong about that?

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: N-no, I guess...

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: OK, OK. You were dissatisfied with your work and asked for a second opinion, but got randomly shouted at instead. Tell me, is it wrong?

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Good. You didn't make amends with her, but you didn't use her mistakes at work to get back at her, either. Instead, you helped her again anyway.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Look, you're really stupid, but have you really done anything wrong?

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: I... have done nothing wrong.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Right, you did nothing wrong, but in the end, she betrayed your trust, stole your files, and damaged company property.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Look, you're now facing this jerk alone. Even if you can't stop her, you muster the courage to record evidence and call the police... If you did that, would you still feel you've done things wrong?

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: No... No, it's the right thing to do! I'm not in the wrong!

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Then do the right thing, stand up for yourself, and don't bow to anyone. Make the real wrongdoer apologize to you!
This is the last message she sent. Rise punches through the computer screen, pulls out a lightsaber, and faces the incoming Corruptors.
On the other end, Bagel stares blankly at the damaged but empty office, as if having just witnessed a paranormal event. Yet, she doesn't feel scared.
Bagel raises her phone and captures the burning "crime scene." The moment the frame freezes, she sees a figure she's never seen before.

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: ...I accept your apology... I know what to write about my character now.

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: Thank you, Rise. Thank you...
